reports.title: Alkami Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Alkami is providing guidance for its fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026 of:
•GAAP total revenue in the range of $139.7 million to $141.2 million;
•Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $30.0 million to $31.0 million.
Alkami is providing guidance for its fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 of:
•GAAP total revenue in the range of $530.5 million to $532.0 million;
•Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $98.0 million to $99.0 million.
